note: Within CD20+ B cells, four-population split on IgD × CD27. Naive: naive B cells — large dense cluster at the lower-right (IgD+, CD27-). Memory_IgDpos: non-switched / IgM memory B cells — upper-right cluster (IgD+, CD27+). Memory_IgDneg: class-switched memory B cells — upper-left cluster (IgD-, CD27+). IgDneg_CD27neg: CD27-negative non-switched B residual (transitional / atypical) — sparse cluster spanning lower-left to mid-left (IgD-, CD27-).
tips: Mature B-cell maturation / class-switch state (IgD × CD27 quadrants, widely used Klein/Sanz scheme). Naive: IgD+ CD27- (surface IgM+ IgD+). Memory_IgDpos: IgD+ CD27+ (the IgM-memory vs MZ-like boundary is not strictly resolved by IgD/CD27 alone). Memory_IgDneg: IgD- CD27+. IgDneg_CD27neg: IgD- CD27-. ABCs are classically T-bet+ CD11c+ — neither marker is in this panel; further sub-classification within DN is not possible from this panel alone. Useful co-markers: CD38 further separates transitional B cells (CD38hi CD24hi, resolved in parallel at Step 4), which sit inside the Naive quadrant here.
